title: How a P-Trap Works in Sink Drainage
description: The P-trap is a critical fixture trap located directly beneath a sink drain outlet. Its curved shape intentionally retains a small pool of clean water after every use, creating a continuous liquid seal between the fixture and the building drainage system. This hydraulic barrier stops foul-smelling and hazardous sewer gases from traveling up the pipe and entering the living space. Additionally, the dip in the trap can catch small items dropped down the drain. Regular water flow ensures the trap seal remains full and effective against evaporation.
